english.title: Fail to present control documents for a special regular international passenger service when required
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) operated a special regular passenger transport service by use of a bus or coach, namely **(..SPECIFY MAKE AND REG..), and failed to present the contract with the organiser, or a copy thereof, and a document evidencing that the passengers constituted a specific category to the exclusion of other passengers for the purposes of a special regular service when requested to do so by an authorised inspecting officer in breach of Article 483(2) of the RPT Chapter
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(1)(c) and 18 of the Road Transport (International Passenger Services) Regulations 2018.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Methu cyflwyno dogfennau rheoli ar gyfer gwasanaeth cludo teithwyr rhyngwladol rheolaidd arbennig yn ôl y gofyn

welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) bu i'r diffynnydd gynnal gwasanaeth cludo teithwyr rheolaidd arbennig gan ddefnyddio bws neu goets, sef **(..SPECIFY MAKE AND REG..), a bu iddynt fethu â chyflwyno'r contract gyda'r trefnydd, neu gopi ohono, a dogfen yn dangos bod y teithwyr o gategori penodol gan eithrio teithwyr eraill er pwrpas gwasanaeth rheolaidd arbennig pan ofynnwyd iddynt wneud hynny gan swyddog archwilio awdurdodedig yn groes i Erthygl 483(2) o'r Bennod RPT.
